Description: Susceptible individuals become infected and move to the first exposed compartment.

Name: δt
Description: Length of discrete time intervals for the SEIR model.

Name: dL
Description: Average incubation period, derived from the rate of becoming infectious σ.

Name: γ
Description: Rate of recovery, representing the daily rate of transition through infectious compartments.

Name: dI
Description: Average infectious period, derived from the recovery rate γ.

Name: λ(t)
Description: Time-varying rate at which a person becomes infected.

Name: β
Description: The constant transmission rate, defined as the rate at which new infections take place given a contact.

Name: ψ
Description: Exponential Growth Rate (EGR), an unknown parameter with a uniform prior distribution.

Name: π
Description: The proportion of the population who is initially susceptible, an unknown parameter with a uniform prior distribution.

Name: λ0
Description: The initial infection rate, an unknown parameter with a uniform prior distribution.

Name: Itot0
Description: The initial total number of infectious people, assumed to be within a specified range.

Name: R0
Description: The basic reproduction number, the average number of successful transmissions per infectious person in a fully susceptible population.

Name: Rn
Description: The effective reproduction number, the average number of successful transmissions per infectious person in a partially susceptible population.

Name: pICU
Description: Probability of ICU admission given infection, an unknown parameter with a uniform prior distribution.

Name: σ²ICU|E
Description: Variance of time from infection to ICU admission, a known parameter.

Name: η
Description: Over-dispersion parameter for the Negative Binomial distribution of weekly ICU admissions, an unknown parameter with a uniform prior.
